CustomField.formula: IF( (LimitsApexPaginationCursorRowsUsed__c / LimitsApexPaginationCursorRowsMax__c * 100) >= 90, "⛔", IF( (LimitsApexPaginationCursorRowsUsed__c / LimitsApexPaginationCursorRowsMax__c * 100) < 90 && (LimitsApexPaginationCursorRowsUsed__c / LimitsApexPaginationCursorRowsMax__c * 100) >= 80, "⚠️", "✅" ) ) + ' ' + IF(LimitsApexPaginationCursorRowsMax__c = 0, '100', TEXT(ROUND(LimitsApexPaginationCursorRowsUsed__c / LimitsApexPaginationCursorRowsMax__c * 100, 2))) + '% (' + TEXT(LimitsApexPaginationCursorRowsUsed__c) + ' / ' + TEXT(LimitsApexPaginationCursorRowsMax__c) + ')'
CustomField.inlineHelpText: ✅ when 80% or less of the limit is used, ⚠️ when 80.1-89.9% is used, or ⛔ when 90% or more is used
CustomField.label: Apex Pagination Cursor Rows
